⚡ SCOOTER vs E-BIKE ⚡

🏍️ Pick your ride. Master the streets. Become the best rider!

🔥 Hit insane WHEELIES & STUNTS
⭐ Earn points and beat your high score
🛠️ Fully CUSTOMIZE your ride
⚙️ Upgrade your vehicle and build the ultimate setup
🏁 RACE against your friends
🚔 ESCAPE from the POLICE
👕 Unlock clothes and create your own style
🏍️ Detailed electric scooters & e-bikes

🛴 SCOOTER vs E-BIKE — choose your side and prove which ride rules the streets!

Explore the city on electric scooters and e-bikes, perform wheelies, race other players, escape police chases and build your dream setup.

💥 New vehicles, customization, upgrades and features coming in future updates!

👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVORITE the game for more updates!
